static_sources.claim: active and reserve XP distribution, 75-percent calculation, record selection, and exclusive logical-ID bound
battle character-to-slot map size, clear loop, and active-slot publication

verified_static_conclusions: Vanilla active-party XP is a three-battle-slot path and is followed by a separate reserve scan.
The reserve scan reads the joined mask, excludes active logical IDs, targets 7E2600 plus logical ID times 0050, awards 15/20 or 75 percent XP, and invokes normal XP and level-up processing.
The reserve loop has exclusive upper bound 07 and therefore processes logical IDs 00-06 only.
The battle character-to-slot map at 7EB1BE contains and initializes exactly seven bytes; direct logical ID 07 reads adjacent 7EB1C5 rather than an initialized map entry.
A reserve logical PC 07 receives no vanilla post-battle XP even if its joined bit is set and its runtime record is otherwise valid.
adapter_requirements: Preserve exact vanilla results for logical IDs 00-06.
Consider logical ID 07 only after a valid v2 load publication agrees with joined bit 01 and exactly one serialized roster occurrence.
Do not award reserve XP when logical ID 07 is active, safe-empty, malformed, duplicated, unbound, or absent from the roster.
Do not widen the seven-byte 7EB1BE map into adjacent WRAM; provide an explicit PC07 active-membership adapter.
Use the natural 7E2830 record only after the complete vanilla compatibility block has been relocated and all PC07 growth and level-up readers have adapters.
limitations: This audit is static and does not execute a battle or victory sequence.
It does not approve a hook, expanded allocation, WRAM ownership claim, runtime record relocation, or production patch.
It does not prove PC07 battle loading, growth rows, HP or MP recomputation, stat growth, Tech Points, post-battle commit, save, load, New Game+, or sidecar publication.
The instruction-site claims are independently derived from the pinned disassembly and canonical ROM; no unlicensed snapshot label is accepted as semantic evidence.
